about: Situations met while forging P_JOL_ROLL, each a chain of events up to its cataclysm, with the solution that got past it. The page of each is an issue ready for GitHub (task almanac:issues:open).

chains.solution: A refused commit is waited out (the time read from the message, an hour when none is named, a minute more) and sent again; commits hold 1000 files (`--batch`). 128 commits of 1000 an hour is what the owner accepted (Q16). `rateLimitWait()` and `committed()` in `src/core/resources/hub.ts`, `tests/hub.test.ts`.
chains.title: Hugging Face refuses the 129th commit of an hour

chains.solution: Texts drop every C0 and C1 control character but tab, new line, carriage return and form feed; a line that held only such characters goes away whole, so it makes no gap that ends a paragraph (`printable()` in `src/core/parsing/pdf.ts`). A text written before is read once on the next `task text`: clean, its record is marked `printable`; holding any, it is made again. `push` holds such texts back and names them before anything is sent (`heldBack()` in `hub.ts`).
chains.title: Hugging Face takes a markdown text for a binary file and refuses the commit

chains.solution: `task resources:prune -- space` deletes there what is not here, in commits of 1000, after a question; it refuses the bucket, whose raw files may live on one machine only. `task resources:space` writes the newest release into the space's Dockerfile, so the next push rebuilds it.
chains.title: The demo space keeps files of its old version

chains.solution: `!resources/locales/` in `.dockerignore`; the Dockerfile copies the packs into the build (the viewer bundles them) and beside `dist/` (node reads them). Checked by building the image here and serving the site from it.
chains.title: The release image does not build: language packs left out of the Docker context

chains.solution: Parts of an address are checked once for every route (`routes.param`: a journal is letters, a year and a position numbers); the remote mode takes only plain paths below its directory (`inside()` in `remote.ts`); `RATE_LIMIT` requests of an address a minute (express-rate-limit, `TRUST_PROXY=1` in the image); the extension takes only an http(s) origin; the devtool's server resolves and stays below its folder; checks with a ref given use no npm cache. `tests/remote.test.ts` sends a raw `..` and sees nothing leave.
chains.title: The first CodeQL scan: 15 alerts, one of them a real path injection

chains.solution: A damaged PDF stops nothing: what poppler still reads is kept, otherwise the act goes to `texts/<j>/<year>.scans.jsonl` with its `error`. Whether the source serves these files so is in `docs/.agents/things-to-check.md`.
chains.title: A damaged PDF stops the whole text run

chains.solution: `repairedName()` in `pdf.ts` reads such pairs back ("Microsoft® Word 2019"); the last letter of an odd length is lost.
chains.title: The producer of some PDFs reads as Chinese

chains.solution: `@go-task/cli` `^3.54.0`, which ends with the task's code. A bad message or a badly formatted file stops the commit now (exit 201).
chains.title: The git hooks printed errors and let every commit through

chains.solution: The ranges put back, `npm update`, then `npm audit fix` without `--force`; advisories that remain are judged by whether data from outside reaches them.
chains.title: `npm audit fix --force` moved packages backwards

chains.solution: `allowScripts` in `package.json`: `@go-task/cli`, `esbuild`, `@swc/core` allowed; the rest denied with the reason.
chains.title: A fresh install has no `task` binary

chains.solution: The day is sent with a time; a run whose requests failed ends with 1.
chains.title: `gather:changes` fails: the API wants a time, not a day

chains.solution: Jobs take scripts from `development`; the workflow turns security updates to `dev/dependabot`; the four open ones were turned through the API and started by `@dependabot rebase`.
chains.title: Dependabot's pull requests do not land by themselves

chains.solution: Left as GitHub made it: the owner approves them. Agents do not.
chains.title: Checks of a pull request opened by a workflow wait for a person

chains.solution: Headers stay short (`flow:land` too); when it happens, `npm pkg set version=<previous>` and `task version:sync` put it back. Earlier a hook stopped after the bump for Biome, so the bump runs after Biome.
chains.title: A refused commit leaves its version bump in the working tree

chains.solution: `.index.json` is imported by name, the packs by the glob.
chains.title: The index of language packs is missing from the viewer

chains.solution: `follow()` takes the Observer as a parameter; that test runs in jsdom, as browsers do.
chains.title: Translations of what Vue renders later cannot be tested in linkedom

chains.solution: Names in `keep`, identifiers and `{named}` places stand in as numbers from 701 while the model works; a text that is one identifier gets no hook; a person fixes an entry and lists it in `reviewed`, which is never overwritten.
chains.title: Machine translation changes names and identifiers

chains.solution: `visibility`, 6-digit colours with alpha apart; a node's position on screen is `graphToViewport(graph.getNodeAttributes(node))`.
chains.title: The map of the law shows hidden edges in wrong colours

chains.solution: `scripts/embeddings/embed.py` writes snappy.
chains.title: The viewer cannot read the vectors

chains.solution: The terminal is cooked before a task, raw again after.
chains.title: Ctrl+C in a task of the launcher does not stop it

chains.solution: internal-dns listens on 15353 (`DNS_PORT`).
chains.title: The internal DNS does not start

chains.solution: The commit with the images committed as a second change; the submodule left out of Biome.
chains.title: The media submodule points at an empty commit, then breaks the lint

chains.solution: Copilot is a member, Jarvis, on its own branch dev/Jarvis: bots.yml turns its pull requests there, merges them when ready, checks the branch on its own commit and lands it in development; its guide (.github/copilot-instructions.md) names the branch.
chains.title: Copilot's pull requests open against master

chains.solution: The space's `Dockerfile` sets `RESOURCES_DIR` and `LOG_DIR` in `/tmp`, and `task resources:space` adds that line when it is missing; the 25945 files the space wrote were deleted from the bucket by their paths (`resources/`, `logs/`), the raw files left as they were.
chains.title: The demo space writes its cache into the bucket
